entities.label: Person
entities.summary: František Trávníček was a Czech Slavist and Bohemist. He was a professor of the Czech language at Masaryk University and an academician of the Czechoslovak Academy of Sciences. After February 1948, he was also a politician of the Communist Party of Czechoslovakia and promoted Marxist interpretations of linguistics.

entities.name: František Trávníček
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: František Trávníček was a Czech Slavist and Bohemist. He was a professor of the Czech language at Masaryk University and an academician of the Czechoslovak Academy of Sciences. After February 1948, he was also a politician of the Communist Party of Czechoslovakia and promoted Marxist interpretations of linguistics.
